m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: That should do it - now follow me!
Take them down, Wizard, but be gentle! Then feed them the Lichen.
The madness has left me. Thank you, stranger!
Let's get out of here, and then you can tell me why you're running into the jungle instead of out of it.
Remember the Aethyr Sensors we set up on Aeriel? I got one and modified it to receive Communicator signals.
If Beans keeps transmitting, we should be able to triangulate his position. I'll need to take several readings to do it.
Wizard, I found you! What did I miss?
You want to head deeper in? Whoa! I'd say you're crazy, but your friends need you.
If anyone can make it through this chaos, you can.
The Jungle's gone mad - too much Life energy is turning peaceful things savage; and Death energy is turning living stuff into ash or fungus.
We were so not ready for this: Gatherers and Wardens are trapped down here, and refugees too - entire villages fell from the sky! So bogus!
A troop of Fruit Gatherers near here have gone feral - their Life force burns too hot. We've got to heal them so they can get to safety.
The Lichens here are soaked with Death magic. If we feed it to the Gatherers it'll dampen their Life essence and restore their minds. Go get some.
We need to feed Lichen to the Feral Gatherers to restore their minds so we can save them.
